name: Pantai Cermin
description: Pantai berpasir putih dengan air yang tenang dan jernih seperti cermin. Cocok untuk keluarga, dengan wahana air, resor, dan kuliner seafood segar di sepanjang bibir pantai.
description_en: A white sandy beach with calm, mirror-clear waters. Perfect for families with water rides, resorts, and fresh seafood along the shore.

name: Air Terjun Sipiso-Piso
description: Air terjun tertinggi di Indonesia dengan ketinggian ±120 meter. Aliran deras jatuh langsung ke lembah dalam dari tebing curam. Akses melalui jalan berkelok dengan viewpoint foto sempurna di atas. Pemandangan indah saat sunrise/sunset. Bisa diakses mobil atau motor.
description_en: Indonesia's highest waterfall at approximately 120 meters tall. Powerful flow plunges directly into deep valley from steep cliff. Access via winding road with perfect photo viewpoints above. Beautiful scenery during sunrise/sunset. Accessible by car or motorcycle.
